questions.text: Background and Context: Explain the broad context of your Water Distribution Optimizer without reading from the document.
questions.answer: In my project, I built a decision-support optimizer for water distribution networks. The project is a simulation-based decision-support system for comparing a baseline water distribution network against an NSGA-II optimized operating strategy. It does not directly control field equipment; it produces recommendations from EPANET hydraulic simulations. The implementation uses The backend uses FastAPI, EPyT/EPANET, DEAP, NumPy, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL. The frontend uses React with Vite, Zustand state management, Axios, and Recharts-style result views. The methodology combines EPANET hydraulic simulation with a DEAP implementation of NSGA-II. Each candidate chromosome represents 24 hours of pump and valve settings, with genes bounded between 0 and 1 and decoded into hourly operating schedules.
